basis: Generated Thrift recv_METHOD calls readMessageBegin, checks header, then a direct presult.read call. Source and object disassembly confirm a callsite after response header receipt; the response body may still block.
reply_policy: Use the compact incoming-RPC policy plus up to eight residual targets at typed client recv_METHOD -> presult.read anchors. Select from original retained training samples associated with that recv/presult context or recent post-header LBR. Only same-process executable targets. Header/RPC method identity is available at runtime; no evaluation future outcomes are read. Targets need >=3 training samples; omit issuing line and already-present same-site local targets. NOP twin disables only the additional reply hints, retaining compact incoming-RPC hints.
screen: Four fixed blocks full/lean/wide/reply, cyclic balanced order. Select highest RPS refined candidate under CPU+0.5% and p99+2% guardrails; if none qualifies independently test fastest nominee without promotion.
confirmation: Six fresh fixed blocks original/full/nominee/nominee_nop, three order/reverse-order pairs, equal mean positions. Individual paired-log t95; promote only positive lower RPS bound vs full plus CPU/p99 guards. No pooling with prior phases.
retention: Fresh L2 captures of all three compact candidates after freezing selection; extract residuals before cleaning rejected executables.
supersedes: wide_predeclared.json screen three arms/three blocks and production five blocks. Existing in-flight timing-pair study remains unchanged.
